articles.title: Threat Intelligence Alone Won't Close the Exploitation Gap
articles.description: A leaked credential shows up in a criminal marketplace, or a vulnerability gets a disclosure advisory, and either one can be weaponized against a real target before most security teams have triaged the alert. Attackers are combining that kind of intelligence with AI-assisted exploitation to accelerate the path from exposure to breach faster than most security programs are built to react.

articles.title: Check Point Warns of Management Server Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks
articles.description:
Attackers exploited a previously unknown flaw in Check Point's Security Management Server in a handful of targeted attacks on July 23, the company said.

articles.title: WordPress Issues Patch for Critical Flaw That Can Enable Code Execution on Some Servers
articles.description:
WordPress has fixed a critical flaw in its core software that lets an attacker with no account make a site load a PHP file from outside its theme folders.

articles.title: Critical Bifrost AI Gateway Flaw Lets Attackers Run Commands Without Credentials
articles.description:
A critical vulnerability in Bifrost, an open-source AI gateway that routes requests to more than 20 LLM providers, allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary commands on the gateway server with a single HTTP request.

articles.title: Researcher Drops BigDiskBuster Zero-Day PoC That Blocks Microsoft Defender Updates
articles.description:

articles.title: New CVSS 10.0 VeloCloud Orchestrator Flaw Actively Exploited in Certificate-Based Setups
articles.description:
Attackers are exploiting a new flaw in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO), the server that manages the Edge devices in a VeloCloud SD-WAN, Arista said on September 22.

articles.title: New Linux Kernel Flaw Gives ARM64 KVM Guests Read-Write Access to Host Memory
articles.description:
A new flaw in the Linux kernel's KVM virtualization code for ARM64 processors can leave a freed piece of host memory exposed to a guest virtual machine on hosts with nested virtualization enabled.

The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-89775, allows a guest to read and write host kernel memory, and the researcher who found it says it can be used to escape the guest and run code on the host machine.

articles.description:

articles.title: One Hidden Meta Muse Setting Could Let Attackers Turn the AI Assistant Into a Backdoor
articles.description:
Malware already running on a Mac can quietly take over Meta's Muse assistant and use the broad access its owner granted the app, security researcher Patrick Wardle has shown in a proof-of-concept released on September 21.

It works by changing a hidden setting so that when the user taps the microphone and dictates a prompt, the words go to the attacker instead of Meta.

articles.title: WordPress Comment2Shell Flaw Can Turn Anonymous Comment XSS Into RCE via Admin Session
articles.description:
A new flaw in WordPress core let an anonymous visitor leave a comment that planted a hidden script on the page. If a logged-in administrator later opened that page, the script could run code on the site's server.

articles.description:

articles.description:
WordPress today released patches to fix a new set of vulnerabilities in its core software, one of which could allow a crafted web link, opened by a logged-in administrator, to install a theme from the official WordPress.org directory without anyone clicking Install.

articles.description:

articles.description:

The cybersecurity vendor said it has identified attacks mounted by NightEagle (aka APT-Q-95), a threat actor known to be active since at least 2023, that involve new techniques for persistence and lateral movement.
